Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

I'm aware that it's a thread that has been descussed earlier, but I didn't find the answer in those WOTs so...  Pls Pascal, can you clarify whether Shadow Court Satyr is allowed to play cards that require dual disciplines on or not?

Shadow Court Satyr (Changeling)

Changeling with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When the Satyr enters play, you may put a combat card from your hand on him. Once each combat, the Satyr may use the ability of that card as if played from your hand. If the card requires a vampire (e.g., costs blood or requires a Discipline), he may use it as a vampire with the basic level of the Discipline (if any).

If SCS is capable of using dual disc. cards, how does he react with Eye of UH?

Eye of Unforgiving Heaven

Discipline: Auspex & Valeren
[aus][val] Strike: 2R aggravated damage to all vampires, demon allies and demon retainers in combat. If this striking vampire is burned during the resolution of this strike, you gain 2 pool.
[AUS][VAL] As above, but the damage done to this striking vampire is normal, not aggravated.

NC of Hungary

///

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: IIRC, "the discipline" is singular, so only one discipline is emulated. And still IIRC, if the card have an outferior you can use it too.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Shadow Court Satyr cannot use a card requiring two (or more) disciplines. The discussion (I think it was here) clarifying it was about the "a Discipline" in his text).  [LSJ 20021612] .

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Pascal, I have an additional question.

My satyr court get an Eye of Unforgiving Heaven. He can't play it, because he cannot emulate both discipline.

I then resolve a Bestow Vigor on him. Can he now play the Eye, using his card text for the Auspex and Bestow for the Fortitude ?

And does he take damage from the Eye ? (which was part of Malachy question, I know)

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> I don't understand the reasoning. He still lacks Valeran , and his text still says singular discipline.
>
The reasoning is : he can play the card as if he were a vampire with one level on the required discipline. Let's say it's valeren. He can play card as if he had inferior fortitude, so he have both requirement.

In other word, I don't know whether the ability work only if there is one requirement beside vampire, or if it waive one discipline, and you can't waive the other by the shadow satyr court cardtext.
